text:
mia: Heads up, a few community sample projects report breakage after we switched to subpath exports in 2.0.0-beta. Seems to hit Deno Deploy and a couple of Cloudflare Workers.

mia: Error from a Deno user: `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot import 'auth' from 'https://cdn...'` — they're doing `import { auth } from '@redwood/inference-js/auth'` which used to work.

rohan: right, the new exports only expose `.` and `./runtime` and we removed deep subpath exports to tidy the surface. Deno and browsers via skypack/unpkg relied on those subpath imports.

tia: our intention was to encourage the single entrypoint, but we forgot to include path-based exports for `./auth` and `./types` and also didn't add an explicit mapping for `.d.ts` files. That explains the TS and Deno failures.

mia: repro steps I ran: `deno run --allow-net https://deno.land/x/samples@latest/mod.ts` with pinned `@redwood/inference-js@2.0.0-beta` and it fails immediately during import resolution.

rohan: additional symptom: one of the sample Next.js edge previews showed `ReferenceError: Headers is not defined` inside our telemetry wrapper — that turned out to be bundler path-picking the server-only telemetry layer instead of the edge variant because of missing conditional exports.

lee: ci-bot: I've triaged a spike in onboarding failures in samples-runner for 2.0.0-beta — failure rate jumped from 1% to 23% for new installs.

mia: immediate mitigation options: (A) add back explicit subpath exports for the few internals we intentionally supported (auth, telemetry/edge, adapters), (B) publish a compatibility package `@redwood/inference-js-compat` that re-exports the old paths, or (C) roll back the change until we have a better compatibility plan.

tia: I'd vote for A + small docs note. It's low-risk and fixes Deno CDN usage and deep imports. We'll need to update our release checklist to include a Deno CDN smoke test.

rohan: implementation detail for A: add entries to package.json.exports like `"./auth": { "import": "./dist/auth/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/auth/index.cjs" }` and `"./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"`. Also include `./package.json` export so bundlers can read fields.

mia: and make sure we include `typesVersions` mapping for older TS resolver versions that don't follow exports for `.d.ts`. Some consumers are on TS 4.1 and fail otherwise.

lee: CI note: I'll add a job that pulls the package from registry and runs a tiny Deno import test + Cloudflare Worker sandbox to smoke the edge import surface.

rohan: small code change: in the build, we already emit `dist/auth/index.mjs` and `dist/auth/index.cjs`, but we had been pruning subpath artifacts during the 2.0 packaging step. I'll adjust the pack script to keep them. Also add `types` entry for the subpaths.

mia: thank you. Can we also add a short devex guide in samples: "If you need deep imports (auth, adapters) prefer the top-level entry unless you are on Deno/CDN; use pinned versions until 2.0 is stable."

tia: agree. I'll draft the changelog blurb: "Regressions: subpath imports and Deno edge import resolution fixed by restoring explicit subpath exports and typings. Recommendation: prefer top-level entry, but subpath imports remain supported for backwards compatibility."

lee: ci-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/401 — adds exports for `./auth`, `./telemetry/edge`, `./adapters/*`, `./types` and adds a Deno smoke test job.

mia: PR LGTM pending small docs update. Can we also run a quick publish-as-beta to internal registry so samples-runner can verify?

rohan: will cut 2.0.0-beta.1 with the fixes and notify the samples owners.

mia: thanks all. Follow-ups: add Deno/edge smoke step to release checklist, ensure `typesVersions` fallback for TS <=4.5, and draft a tiny blurb in onboarding docs about prefer top-level import for stability.

ci-bot: CI green on fix/exports-restore. Samples-runner verified Deno import resolution.

mia: closing thread, will watch for new reports but this should close most onboarding friction. :raised_hands:
